global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with chashu pork, a soft-boiled egg, and nori seaweed. Served in a white bowl with blue trim, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface with dark brown grain patterns and visible seams between planks.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue rim, smooth glossy surface, slightly chipped edge, and faint residue stains inside.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy, golden-brown, and thick, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
regions.egg: A whole boiled egg, pale yellow, smooth, oval-shaped, with subtle surface sheen and faint speckles.
regions.seaweed: Dark green nori seaweed, irregularly shaped, with textured surface and visible specks, appears slightly curled.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slices show golden-brown color, tender texture, irregular shape, and sesame seeds on their surface.
